headline: KEYCORP CLOSES ACQUISITION OF CLEARWATER CORPORATE FINANCE LLP
summary: KeyCorp (NYSE: KEY) announced today that it has completed its previously-announced acquisition of Clearwater Corporate Finance LLP ("Clearwater UK"), a leading UK-based middle market investment banking advisory firm.
